stages.event: You've arrived at the Glacier location! Time to start your journey.

choices.1: Attack a nearby Ice Shard to test your strength
choices.2: Observe the surroundings to learn more about the area
choices.3: Boost your energy to prepare for challenges ahead

stages.event: As you explore the area, you notice a few Ice Shards on the ground. What do you do?

choices.1: Destroy all the Ice Shards with your attack
choices.2: Try to collect and move the Ice Shards with your agility
choices.3: Leave the Ice Shards alone to avoid disturbing the area

stages.event: A Frost Wolf blocks your path! Can you scare it away?

choices.1: Use your high attack power to scare it
choices.2: Show off your intelligence to distract the wolf
choices.3: Boost your happiness to make the wolf leave peacefully

stages.event: The Polar Bear charges at you! Can you dodge?

choices.1: Use your quick reflexes to dodge the attack
choices.2: Use your agility to outmaneuver the bear
choices.3: Try to intimidate the bear with a strong defense stance

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: A chest in the distance looks like a treasure trove! What do you do?

choices.1: Try to open the chest with a strong defense
choices.2: Use your agility to move the chest around and see what's inside
choices.3: Boost your energy to prepare for any potential challenges

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You found a treasure chest with double loot!

choices.1: Take a risk and try to open it with your high attack power
choices.2: Use your agility to carefully move the chest to reveal its contents
choices.3: Boost your happiness to make the chest reward you

stages.event: You've finished exploring the Glacier location! What do you do next?

choices.1: Attack a nearby enemy to test your strength
choices.2: Observe the surroundings to learn more about the area
choices.3: Return to safety and boost your energy to prepare for further challenges
